title: Los Totes 2 — Limited Edition 12"
description:
The second vinyl edition of the label's most celebrated tracks, some unreleased remixes, and other rarities that will be available only on wax.

A1. Bitter Babe — Nadie lo puede parar

A2. Nick León — Toma (2023)

A3. Verraco — Ronaldinho hace la elástica

B1. Doctor Jeep — Push The Body

B2. Tomás Urquieta — 32 Balas (Rhyw’ Double Dribble remix)

B3. Luca Durán + Nick León — Joga Bola ( Identified Patient & Gamma Intel remix)

Boomkat: Colombia’s TraTraTrax drive the dance to boiling point with upfront bangers. A surefire example of the prevailing hold of contemporary L*tin club music over international dances, finding the ideal balance of kinky offbeat and heads-down propulsion systems that work so damn effectively from Bogotá to Manchestá, Brooklyn, and Amsterdam.
